rows.summary: Core fetch/network effects bypass purity
rows.evidence: Isolated core fetch fixture returned no diagnostics; add normalized impure-global detection.
rows.action: Normalized global access now rejects fetch and network constructors; the regression fixture asserts exact locations.

rows.summary: Deterministic Date operations are rejected
rows.evidence: AD-1 expressly prohibits all Date calls; rejection is the specified policy, including deterministic Date operations.

rows.summary: Computed/qualified random APIs bypass purity
rows.evidence: Math["random"] and globalThis.crypto.randomUUID both returned no diagnostics.
rows.action: Property and literal computed global chains reject qualified crypto and Math.random; all twelve effect forms are exercised.

rows.summary: Root script imports have no dependency owner
rows.evidence: Non-test script importing an undeclared package returned no diagnostics.
rows.action: Root scripts now have a manifest owner and declaration checks; final verification also exposed Fastify test use, declared in root devDependencies.

rows.summary: Unexported workspace roots/null exports pass
rows.evidence: Reproduced omitted-dot root and null private subpath acceptance against installed checker.
rows.action: Export resolution now distinguishes root/subpath, conditional targets, null and wildcard denial with negative fixtures.

rows.summary: node:sqlite bypasses DB ownership
rows.evidence: Server DatabaseSync import/constructor fixture returned no diagnostics.
rows.action: node:sqlite and sqlite are included in DB-only ownership checks.

rows.summary: Zero-line executable report evidence passes
rows.evidence: Executable core module with zero measured lines passed when another source supplied totals.
rows.action: Executable source detection now requires positive measured lines per source; empty/type-only/forwarding modules remain valid.

rows.summary: Foreign report entries inflate package coverage
rows.evidence: Uncovered core plus covered foreign web path passed at66.67percent.
rows.action: Reports reject paths outside the workspace intended-source inventory before accepting package evidence.

rows.summary: Tracked gzip evidence bypasses secret signatures
rows.evidence: Synthetic supported signature in tracked gzip returned no diagnostics; source plaintext detector recognizes that signature. No real credential exposure is alleged.
rows.action: Tracked gzip bytes are decompressed and checked for supported signatures; malformed archives fail safely. Synthetic regression and 426 existing archives were checked without modifying bytes.

rows.summary: Card Detail context duplicates ninety forwarded fields
rows.evidence: New helper manually rebuilds existing state shape; direct model spread removes introduced forwarding duplication without behavior change.
rows.action: Card Detail context now spreads its model instead of rebuilding ninety fields; both modal suites pass56tests.

rows.summary: Public orchestration has helper-only negative evidence
rows.evidence: Coverage/license commands lack caller-level failures; shared process tests and boundary-first aggregate test do not detect those omitted orchestration branches. Address with G2/G3.
rows.action: Actual coverage and license CLI negative tests now assert nonzero caller outcomes; shared child/signal and real aggregate boundary-failure tests remain.

rows.summary: Test usage can satisfy runtime dependency usage
rows.evidence: Reproduced runtime dependency used only in a test passing the unused gate; distinguish non-test and development usage.
rows.action: Production use is tracked separately from tests/tools; runtime dependencies used only for development are rejected.

rows.summary: English guard remains a German-token heuristic
rows.evidence: Pre-existing findViolations algorithm is preserved; no universal language classifier is claimed. Other-language copy needs an acceptance corpus and language review; retain this finite-detector limitation explicitly.

rows.summary: Secret signatures do not establish exhaustive secret/history audit
rows.evidence: Current gate explicitly implements supported signature and tracked-path checks; no exhaustive history/unknown-secret certification is claimed. Concrete gzip omission is separately patched as B9.

rows.summary: License gate does not certify redistribution obligations
rows.evidence: Story8.3 requests compatibility allowlist, not publication certification. Policy and command explicitly retain upstream obligations; later publication gates remain open.

rows.summary: Structural test parity does not prove semantics
rows.evidence: No claim relies on counts alone: full runtime suites, real launcher/transport checks and independent489-node CSS AST equivalence also ran. Specific missing human parser assertion is patched as G1.

rows.summary: Only Darwin execution is established
rows.evidence: This story supplies local checks; three-platform execution is Story8.4. Evidence expressly retains Windows/Linux/native-reader limits and makes no all-platform claim.

rows.summary: Human HTTP Markdown parser selection lacks structural assertions
rows.evidence: Pre-verified gap: current HTTP test checks body text; direct DB/parity tests inject parsedChunks. Exact heading/locator persistence must be asserted at HTTP import.
rows.action: The real human HTTP test now asserts exact nested Markdown headings, source locators and stable repeated-import chunk identities.

rows.summary: Coverage orchestration can omit final workspace undetected
rows.evidence: Pre-verified gap: tests invoke inspectCoverage, not checkCoverage CLI; slice(0,-1) would evade assertions. Add final-workspace-failure CLI evidence.
rows.action: The actual coverage CLI fixture records all eight visits and requires a final server floor failure after preceding passes.

rows.summary: License inspection violations lack CLI exit assertion
rows.evidence: Pre-verified gap: removing violations throw evades helper tests. Add incompatible installed metadata through actual license CLI.
rows.action: The actual license CLI installs an offline local GPL tarball and requires nonzero exit with package/version diagnostic.

rows.summary: Pure-core global effects bypass checks
rows.evidence: Same reproduced fetch/qualified-random defect as B1/B3.
rows.action: Same global-access normalization as B1/B3; dedicated source-location regressions cover all reported forms.

rows.summary: Nonliteral imports/require evade import checks
rows.evidence: Reproduced core import(name) acceptance; inventory found zero current authored nonliteral calls. Fail unresolved dependency syntax with location.
rows.action: Nonliteral import/require forms now emit unresolved-dependency diagnostics with exact source locations.

rows.summary: Exports-map absent root/null target bypasses gate
rows.evidence: Same reproduced public-entry defect as B5.
rows.action: Same root/null/conditional export resolution repair as B5, including exact null denial before wildcard fallback.

rows.summary: Board diagnostics do not run in aggregate
rows.evidence: Both board suites were diagnostic-only and excluded from standard acceptance before this change. Binding preparation preserves diagnostic-only timing; all required blocking serial audit/a11y suites ran.
